More commands and privacy
During rep entry, say “pause workout”, “end workout”, or “discard workout”, then “confirm”. Use the on-screen controls to resume or start conditioning. Voice rests during countdowns and recovery. If Chrome asks, enable voice when the exercise begins. Speech may be processed by your browser’s speech service.

Body measurements
MANUAL ENTRY
Selected scale: white Etekcity EFS-C671-WUST · VeSync · USB-C. Automatic VeSync/Bluetooth scale sync is not connected. Enter a reading from the scale or app; no account password is needed here.
12-week evaluation
Record the baseline and follow-up 1-mile run and 1-rep-max lifts. Use a consistent exercise, technique and unit for comparison. Results do not automatically change the workout plan.

Import a full HIT backup or original Pure v1 backup. Review, then merge without replacing current sessions. An active session from a backup is not applied automatically.
No cloud sync, background monitoring or AI coach is active. Original Pure and V3.5 data are not read or changed by this separate origin.
